title: Resolve tenant ledger skew caused by idempotent proxy multiplexing during regional handoff
creator: Priya Nair
description:
Summary:
Multiple customers reported unexpected month-to-date usage deltas after a regional handoff event on 2026-02-18. Investigation shows tenant ledger skew where a subset of requests were double-counted across Hosted and Dedicated routing paths during proxy multiplexing and idempotent-replay windows. This ticket tracks the hotfix, reconciliation backfill, customer credits, and long-term fixes to prevent recurrence.

Background & impact:
- Incident: regional handoff (primary->standby) triggered proxy reconnects and request replay logic in the edge multiplexer.
- Symptom: Small percentage of requests had twin attributions: one attributed to the original node and one to the standby path after replay. Result: tenant-level ledger increases for the affected billing window leading to billing deltas for ~12 customers (CS-9876, CS-9902, CS-9914).
- Scope: affects Hosted and Dedicated flows that used idempotent muxing + connection handoff; Private deployments only affected if using the managed edge proxy.
- Severity: P0 (customer escalations + potential invoice impact).

Reproduction notes (internal):
1) Simulate connection tear and reconnect in the multiplexer with idempotency-header present and rapid retry enabled.
2) Force partial session handoff during KV-cache rehydrate to reproduce dual emissions.
3) Observe aggregator's windowed coalescing emitting two ledger rows when request_fingerprint differs between original and replayed envelope.

Root cause hypothesis (finalized after tracing):
- The edge multiplexer attempted an idempotent replay using a locally generated replay-id that did not preserve the canonical request fingerprint used by the billing ingest pipeline.
- The billing aggregator uses a 60s coalescing window keyed on (tenant, canonical_request_id). When the replay generated a different canonical_request_id (due to proxy rewrite and missing X-Redwood-Orig-Id), the aggregator treated the replay as a new request instead of a de-dup, creating two ledger rows.
- Race condition: the multiplexer replay and the original emission occasionally straddle aggregator flush boundaries, leading to both being committed.

Mitigation applied (short-term/hotfix):
- Deployed proxy hotfix (edge-proxy v2.14.1) that preserves X-Redwood-Orig-Id and sets X-Redwood-Request-Fingerprint for all replayed requests. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/5432)
- Adjusted billing aggregator to perform idempotency checks using alternate headers when present (temporary safe-guard). (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/invoice-aggregator/pull/1289)
- Coordinated a canary: rolled to 5% of traffic in us-west-2 and observed no new duplicates for 48 hours.

Reconciliation & backfill plan:
1) Run a backfill job that detects duplicate request fingerprints within the billing window and collapses duplicates into a single ledger emission. Job: jobs/reconcile-duplicate-requests v0.3.
2) For customers with credit variance > $5, manual review and customer-visible credit adjustments will be applied. Initial candidate list attached.
3) Full audit export stored at s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2026-02-handback-ledger-skew.csv for finance and support.
4) Backfill executed for the affected window (2026-02-17T22:00Z -> 2026-02-19T06:00Z) on 2026-03-10; reconciliation completed 2026-03-11.

Verification & metrics to watch post-rollback:
- Duplicate ledger row rate (target < 0.01%) in the next 7 days.
- Customer-reported credit differences closed (target: all <= $0.50 without manual intervention).
- Ingest latency for aggregator unchanged (+/- 5%).

Long-term fix & proposals (next steps):
- Canonical request fingerprinting: extend request signing at ingress to include deterministic tenant+timestamp+sequence and persist across retries. (RFC: confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/Canonical+Request+Fingerprint)
- Replace windowed-only de-dup with idempotent dedupe table in aggregator for 24h TTL for Cross-region handoffs.
- Add synthetic test to chaos suite that simulates regional handoffs with muxed replays.
- Postmortem doc / customer comms prepared and awaiting review.

Customer comms & support items:
- Support tickets: CS-9876 (ACME Corp), CS-9902 (NimbleAI), CS-9914 (AtlasHealth).
- Draft customer email and credit memo templates: confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/Feb+2026+Ledger+Skew+Customer+Comms

Artifacts & links:
- Edge proxy hotfix PR: github.com/redwood-inference/edge-proxy/pull/5432
- Aggregator safe-guard PR: github.com/redwood-inference/invoice-aggregator/pull/1289
- Backfill job repo: github.com/redwood-inference/billing-tools/tree/reconcile-duplicates
- Audit CSV: s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2026-02-handback-ledger-skew.csv
